senses.title: The social movement
senses.definition: the organised movement that campaigns for protection of air, water, land and wildlife
senses.definitionCN: 为保护空气、水、土地与野生生物而开展行动的有组织运动
senses.example: Environmentalism grew rapidly after the oil spill.
senses.exampleCN: 漏油事件之后，环境保护主义迅速发展。
senses.why: The -ism ending marks a movement or doctrine, so the word names collective action rather than a single opinion.
senses.whyCN: -ism 词尾标记运动或学说，因此这个词命名的是集体行动，而不是单个意见。

senses.title: Environmental awareness
senses.definition: a general concern for environmental quality in daily choices and public debate
senses.definitionCN: 在日常选择与公共讨论中对环境质量的普遍关切
senses.example: Environmentalism changed how households sorted their waste.
senses.exampleCN: 环保意识改变了家庭分类垃圾的方式。
senses.why: The movement's ideas diffuse into habits, and the same noun can name that broad awareness.
senses.whyCN: 运动的理念扩散为习惯，同一个名词也能指这种广泛的意识。

senses.title: A philosophical position
senses.definition: the view that environmental values should constrain economic and political decisions
senses.definitionCN: 认为环境价值应约束经济与政治决策的观点
senses.example: Environmentalism argues that clean air is not a luxury.
senses.exampleCN: 环境主义主张清洁空气并非奢侈品。
senses.why: As a doctrine, the word competes with other value systems rather than merely describing a campaign.
senses.whyCN: 作为一种学说，这个词与其他价值体系竞争，而不只是描述一场运动。

senses.title: Practical environmental action
senses.definition: the practice of reducing harm through recycling, conservation and low-impact choices
senses.definitionCN: 通过回收、节约与低影响选择减少伤害的实践
senses.example: Her environmentalism showed in the way she repaired rather than replaced things.
senses.exampleCN: 她的环保实践体现在修东西而不是换东西上。
senses.why: The abstract noun can describe lived behaviour, not only organisations and manifestos.
senses.whyCN: 这个抽象名词也能描述实际行为，而不只是组织与宣言。

senses.title: A field of political ecology
senses.definition: in academic study, the political dimension of environmental conflicts and governance
senses.definitionCN: 学术研究中环境冲突与治理的政治维度
senses.example: The course examines environmentalism through the lens of political ecology.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程从政治生态学的视角考察环境主义。
senses.why: Academic use treats environmentalism as an object of analysis, with actors, institutions and power.
senses.whyCN: 学术用法把环境主义当作分析对象，关注行动者、制度与权力。

senses.title: Corporate environmentalism
senses.definition: the adoption of environmental goals by firms, often through efficiency and public reporting
senses.definitionCN: 企业采纳环境目标，常通过效率提升与公开报告实现
senses.example: Corporate environmentalism produced a sustainability report but little change on the ground.
senses.exampleCN: 企业环境主义产出了一份可持续报告，但实地改变甚微。
senses.why: When business adopts the language of the movement, the word marks a contested version of it.
senses.whyCN: 当企业采用这场运动的语言时，这个词标出的是它一个有争议的版本。

senses.title: Radical environmentalism
senses.definition: the strand that seeks deep structural change or defends nature against development outright
senses.definitionCN: 寻求深层结构改变或直接反对开发自然的一支
senses.example: Radical environmentalism blocked the dam before the permit was granted.
senses.exampleCN: 激进环保主义在大坝获批之前就阻止了它。
senses.why: The adjective radical marks a position within the movement, not a separate movement.
senses.whyCN: 形容词 radical 标记的是运动内部的一个立场，而不是另一场运动。

senses.title: A stance in policy debate
senses.definition: a position taken in debates over regulation, energy and land use
senses.definitionCN: 在监管、能源与土地利用争论中采取的立场
senses.example: The vote split along environmentalism versus economic growth.
senses.exampleCN: 这次投票沿「环境主义对经济增长」的界线分裂。
senses.why: In policy language the word becomes a side in a dispute, often used by both supporters and opponents.
senses.whyCN: 在政策语言中，这个词成了争论中的一方，支持者与反对者都常使用它。

intro.en: Environmentalism is environment plus -al, -ment and -ism; the oldest part is a French word for 'around'.
intro.cn: environmentalism 是 environment 加上 -al、-ment、-ism；其中最早的部分是一个表示「环绕」的法语词。

items.en: Environment goes back to Old French environ, 'around', from en- 'in' and viron 'circuit', related to virer 'to turn'. The image is what surrounds a thing.
items.cn: environment 上溯古法语 environ「在周围」，由 en-「在内」与 viron「一圈」构成，与 virer「转动」相关。其意象是「围绕某物之物」。

items.en: English environment appears in the seventeenth century for surroundings in general, and only later for the natural world as a system.
items.cn: 英语 environment 在 17 世纪出现，泛指周围环境，后来才指作为系统的自然界。

items.en: The suffix -ism comes through French and Latin from Greek -ismos, marking a practice, doctrine or movement, as in realism and activism.
items.cn: 后缀 -ism 经法语与拉丁语上溯希腊语 -ismos，标记实践、学说或运动，如 realism、activism。

items.en: Environmentalism first names the theory that surroundings shape behaviour, especially in psychology and sociology. This older sense is now rare.
items.cn: environmentalism 最早指「环境塑造行为」的理论，尤其在心理学与社会学中。这一较早义项如今已少见。

items.en: From the mid-twentieth century the word has mainly meant the movement to protect nature, especially after the postwar environmental legislation and the first Earth Day in 1970. The exact date of the shift is not firmly established.
items.cn: 自 20 世纪中叶起，这个词主要指保护自然的运动，尤其在战后环境立法与 1970 年首个地球日之后。这一转变的确切年代尚无定论。

note.en: The first group is easily confused with the movement noun; the second holds related movements and outlooks.
note.cn: 第一组容易与表示运动的名词混淆；第二组是相关运动与观念。

entries.definition: A person who supports environmental protection; environmentalism is the movement or belief.
entries.definitionCN: 支持环境保护的人；environmentalism 是运动或信念。

entries.definition: The surroundings themselves, natural or social; the -ism names the commitment to protect them.
entries.definitionCN: 指周围环境本身，自然或社会皆可；-ism 名词指保护它们的承诺。

entries.definition: The scientific study of organisms and their surroundings; environmentalism is a movement of values.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生物与其环境的科学；environmentalism 是价值取向的运动。

entries.definition: The older movement to manage natural resources wisely; environmentalism is broader and more pollution-focused.
entries.definitionCN: 更早的合理管理自然资源运动；environmentalism 范围更广，更关注污染。

entries.definition: The strand that seeks to protect nature from use altogether; conservationism allows careful use.
entries.definitionCN: 主张完全不用自然以保护它的一支；conservationism 允许谨慎利用。

entries.definition: Campaigning and direct action for a cause; environmentalism is one cause that activists may pursue.
entries.definitionCN: 为某一事业开展运动与直接行动；环保主义是行动者可能追求的一种事业。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the -ism ending, the movement's history and its related forms.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：-ism 词尾、运动的历史与相关词形。

normal.en: environment + -al + -ism: the doctrine of caring for surroundings.
normal.cn: environment + -al + -ism：关怀周围环境的学说。

normal.en: The person is an environmentalist; the adjective is environmental.
normal.cn: 人是 environmentalist，形容词是 environmental。

normal.en: Phrases show the movement's varieties: grassroots, corporate and radical environmentalism.
normal.cn: 搭配显示运动的变体：草根、企业与激进环保主义。

normal.en: The modern sense rose after the Second World War, especially around 1970.
normal.cn: 现代义项在二战后兴起，尤其在 1970 年前后。

normal.en: The root image is simply 'what surrounds us'.
normal.cn: 词根意象很简单：就是「环绕我们之物」。

abstract.en: Think of a house with no walls: environmentalism is the argument that the surroundings are part of the home.
abstract.cn: 想象一座没有墙的房子：环保主义主张周围环境也是家的一部分。

abstract.en: Environmentalism turns a river from a pipe into a neighbour.
abstract.cn: 环保主义把一条河从「管道」变成「邻居」。

abstract.en: Corporate environmentalism is a company wearing the movement's jacket; check whether the sleeves are real.
abstract.cn: 企业环境主义是公司穿上了运动的外套；要看看袖子是不是真的。

examples.en: Modern environmentalism began with concerns about air and water pollution.
examples.cn: 现代环境保护主义始于对空气与水污染的担忧。

examples.en: Grassroots environmentalism stopped the landfill outside the town.
examples.cn: 草根环保运动阻止了城外的垃圾填埋场。

examples.en: The book traces environmentalism from conservation to climate policy.
examples.cn: 这本书追溯了环保主义从自然保护到气候政策的发展。

dict_mnemonic.text: environment（环境）+ al + ism（主义）→ 环境保护主义

root: environment 来自古法语 environ「在周围」（en- + viron「一圈」，与 virer「转动」相关）+ -ment；再加 -al 与 -ism（希腊语 -ismos，标记学说或运动）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all concern commitment to the environment: the movement, public awareness, a doctrine, daily practice, academic political ecology, corporate adoption, a radical strand and a policy side.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都涉及对环境的承诺：运动、公众意识、学说、日常实践、学术政治生态学、企业采纳、激进一支与政策立场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: people organised around the claim that our surroundings deserve protection.
core.cn: 核心意象：人们围绕「周围环境值得保护」这一主张组织起来。

branches.en: THE CORE: organised campaigns and everyday concern both sit under the same name.
branches.cn: 核心：有组织的运动与日常关切都归在同一个名称之下。

branches.en: THE ARGUMENT: as a doctrine it enters policy debate as one side among others.
branches.cn: 论证：作为一种学说，它作为多方之一进入政策争论。

branches.en: THE PRACTICE: the beliefs show up in repair, recycling and low-impact choices.
branches.cn: 实践：信念体现在修理、回收与低影响选择中。

branches.en: THE STUDY: political ecology analyses the movement's actors and power relations.
branches.cn: 研究：政治生态学分析这场运动的行动者与权力关系。

branches.en: THE VARIANTS: firms adopt the language, while radicals demand structural change.
branches.cn: 变体：企业采纳其语言，激进派则要求结构改变。

intro.en: Environmentalism stacks a French root with three suffixes that turn it into a doctrine.
intro.cn: environmentalism 把一个法语词根叠加三个后缀，使之成为学说名词。

latinIntro.en: Environ is French; -ment is French from Latin -mentum; -al is Latin -alis; -ism is Greek -ismos through Latin. No single Latin root carries the meaning.
latinIntro.cn: environ 来自法语；-ment 来自拉丁语 -mentum（经法语）；-al 来自拉丁语 -alis；-ism 来自希腊语 -ismos（经拉丁语）。没有一个单独的拉丁词根承担全部意义。

items.example: Environmentalism shaped the city's transport plan.
items.exampleCN: 环保主义影响了这座城市的交通规划。

items.example: The environment bears the cost of growth.
items.exampleCN: 环境承担增长的代价。

items.example: Environmental law grew alongside the movement.
items.exampleCN: 环境法与这场运动同步发展。

items.example: The environmentalist testified before the committee.
items.exampleCN: 这位环保主义者向委员会作证。

items.meaning: the doctrine of wise resource use
items.example: Conservationism preceded modern environmentalism.
items.exampleCN: 资源保护主义先于现代环保主义。

items.meaning: the doctrine of leaving nature untouched
items.meaningCN: 主张不触碰自然的学说
items.example: Preservationism and conservationism split over use.
items.exampleCN: 保存主义与保护主义因「是否利用」而分裂。

items.example: Activism is the method; environmentalism is one cause.
items.exampleCN: 行动主义是方法，环保主义是其中一项事业。

items.meaning: the science of organisms and surroundings
items.meaningCN: 研究生物与环境的科学
items.example: Ecology supplies evidence; environmentalism supplies purpose.
items.exampleCN: 生态学提供证据，环保主义提供目的。

latinEntries.meaning: result or means of an action

definition_zh: 自然保护者；环保主义者；文物保护者
definition_en: a person who works to protect natural resources, wildlife or valued objects from loss or damage
core_image: 一位护林员站在新种的树苗之间，记录着每一片恢复的林地
scene: The conservationist spent thirty years restoring the drained marsh.
sceneCN: 这里 conservationist 是「自然保护者」（第 1 个义项：从事自然与野生生物保护的人）；句意：这位自然保护者花了三十年恢复那片被排干的沼泽。

pos.zh: 自然保护者；环保主义者；文物保护者（可数，复数 conservationists）

derivatives.zh: 保守的；保存性的（同词根，语义分化）

senses.title: A protector of nature
senses.definition: a person who works to protect ecosystems, species or natural places
senses.definitionCN: 从事保护生态系统、物种或自然场所的人
senses.example: The conservationist mapped the last remaining nesting beach.
senses.exampleCN: 这位自然保护者绘制了最后一片尚存的筑巢海滩。
senses.why: The -ist ending marks a person committed to the practice named by the base noun, so the word names a role rather than an emotion.
senses.whyCN: -ist 词尾标记投入某项实践的人，因此这个词命名的是一个角色，而不是一种情绪。

senses.title: A resource steward
senses.definition: a person who argues for wise, sustained use of soil, water, forests and minerals
senses.definitionCN: 主张对土壤、水、森林与矿产进行明智、可持续利用的人
senses.example: The conservationist wanted logging limits rather than a total ban.
senses.exampleCN: 这位资源保护论者想要限制伐木，而不是全面禁止。
senses.why: The older conservation movement separated careful use from outright preservation, and this sense keeps that distinction.
senses.whyCN: 较早的保护运动把「谨慎利用」与「完全保存」分开，这个义项保留了那一区分。

senses.title: A wildlife worker
senses.definition: a person employed in managing or recovering wild animal populations
senses.definitionCN: 受雇管理或恢复野生动物种群的人
senses.example: Conservationists radio-tagged the reintroduced wolves.
senses.exampleCN: 保护工作者给放归的狼佩戴了无线电项圈。
senses.why: Professional practice needs a job title, and the word moves from advocacy to field work.
senses.whyCN: 职业实践需要一个职务名称，这个词于是从倡导转向野外工作。

senses.title: A keeper of cultural objects
senses.definition: a person who protects artworks, buildings or artefacts from damage or decay
senses.definitionCN: 保护艺术品、建筑或文物免受损坏或衰变的人
senses.example: The conservationist stabilised the fresco before the gallery reopened.
senses.exampleCN: 这位文物保护者在展厅重新开放前对壁画做了加固。
senses.why: Conservation is not limited to nature; museums use the same word for stopping decay in objects.
senses.whyCN: 保护并不限于自然；博物馆用同一个词指阻止物品衰变。

senses.title: An advocate of efficiency
senses.definition: a person who promotes reducing energy or material waste
senses.definitionCN: 倡导减少能源或材料浪费的人
senses.example: The conservationist argued that the cheapest power is the power not used.
senses.exampleCN: 这位节能倡导者主张，最便宜的电力是没被用掉的电力。
senses.why: The word's root means 'to keep', and keeping resources includes not wasting them.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的词根意为「保存」，保存资源就包括不浪费它们。

senses.title: A soil and water protector
senses.definition: a specialist who prevents erosion, depletion or pollution of soil and water
senses.definitionCN: 防止土壤与水受到侵蚀、枯竭或污染的专业人员
senses.example: The soil conservationist planted windbreaks along the field edges.
senses.exampleCN: 这位土壤保护者沿田边种下防风林带。
senses.why: Early twentieth-century conservation was largely about soil and water, and the job title survives in agencies.
senses.whyCN: 20 世纪初的保护工作主要围绕土壤与水，这一职务名称仍存在于相关机构中。

senses.title: A policy advocate
senses.definition: a person who campaigns for laws, reserves or funding that protect the environment
senses.definitionCN: 为保护环境的立法、保护区或资金奔走的人
senses.example: Conservationists won a ten-year moratorium on the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 保护倡导者赢得了山脊十年的开采禁令。
senses.why: Protection often depends on rules, so the same word names those who work through institutions.
senses.whyCN: 保护往往依赖规则，因此同一个词也指通过制度工作的人。

senses.title: A reserve manager
senses.definition: a person responsible for the day-to-day management of a protected area
senses.definitionCN: 负责保护区日常管理的人
senses.example: The conservationist balanced visitor access with nesting season.
senses.exampleCN: 这位保护区管理者在游客开放与筑巢季之间取得平衡。
senses.why: Management is conservation in daily practice, and the title covers routine decisions as well as campaigns.
senses.whyCN: 管理是日常实践中的保护，这个称谓既涵盖日常决策，也涵盖运动倡导。

intro.en: Conservationist is conservation plus -ist; the base verb means 'to keep together, preserve'.
intro.cn: conservationist 是 conservation 加 -ist；其基础动词意为「保持、保存」。

items.en: Conserve comes from Latin conservare, 'to keep, preserve', made of com- (intensive) and servare, 'to keep, watch over'. The same servare gives preserve, reserve and observe.
items.cn: conserve 来自拉丁语 conservare「保持、保存」，由 com-（加强）与 servare「守护、看守」构成。同一个 servare 也产生 preserve、reserve 与 observe。

items.en: Conservation entered English in the fourteenth century with the general sense of preservation, long before it named nature protection.
items.cn: conservation 在 14 世纪进入英语，泛指保存，远早于它指自然保护。

items.en: The -ist ending marks a person devoted to a practice or doctrine, as in artist and scientist. It reached English through French and Latin from Greek -istes.
items.cn: -ist 词尾标记投入某项实践或学说的人，如 artist、scientist。它经法语与拉丁语上溯希腊语 -istes。

items.en: The modern sense arose with nineteenth-century forest and soil conservation, especially in the United States, where sustained yield became policy. The exact first use of conservationist is not firmly dated.
items.cn: 现代义项随 19 世纪的森林与土壤保护运动兴起，尤其在美国，「持续产量」成为政策。conservationist 的确切首见年代尚无定论。

items.en: The same word was adopted by museums and heritage bodies for those who stabilise and repair valued objects.
items.cn: 博物馆与文化遗产机构也采用同一个词，指对珍贵物品进行加固与修复的人。

note.en: The first group is easily confused with related forms; the second holds other environmental roles.
note.cn: 第一组容易与相关词形混淆；第二组是其他环境角色。

entries.definition: The practice or policy of protecting resources; conservationist is the person who carries it out.
entries.definitionCN: 指保护资源的实践或政策；conservationist 是执行者。

entries.definition: The belief in wise resource use; a conservationist is a person holding or practising it.
entries.definitionCN: 指合理利用资源的信念；conservationist 是持有或实践这一信念的人。

entries.definition: Cautious about change, especially in politics; it shares conservare but not the environmental sense.
entries.definitionCN: 对改变持谨慎态度，尤指政治上；与 conservare 同根，但不含环境保护义。

entries.definition: A supporter of the environmental movement; conservationist often stresses practical protection of resources and places.
entries.definitionCN: 环保运动支持者；conservationist 常强调对资源与场所的实际保护。

entries.definition: A person who wants nature left untouched; a conservationist may allow careful, sustained use.
entries.definitionCN: 主张不触碰自然的人；conservationist 可能允许谨慎、可持续的利用。

entries.definition: A scientist who studies ecosystems; a conservationist may act on that science without doing research.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生态系统的科学家；conservationist 可能依据这些科学行动，但不一定做研究。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the keeping root, the -ist person ending and the field variants.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：「保存」词根、-ist 人称词尾与领域变体。

normal.en: conservare 'to keep' + -ist 'person': a person who keeps resources safe.
normal.cn: conservare「保存」+ -ist「人」：守护资源的人。

normal.en: The family runs conserve, conservation, conservationism, conservationist.
normal.cn: 同族词有 conserve、conservation、conservationism、conservationist。

normal.en: Phrases show the fields: wildlife, soil and local conservationists.
normal.cn: 搭配显示领域：野生生物、土壤与地方保护工作者。

normal.en: The same word appears in museums for people who stabilise paintings.
normal.cn: 同一个词也出现在博物馆里，指对画作做加固的人。

normal.en: The contrast worth remembering is conservationist versus preservationist.
normal.cn: 值得记住的对比是 conservationist 与 preservationist。

abstract.en: Think of someone repairing a roof that everyone else only complains about.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人去修补屋顶，而其他人只会在旁边抱怨。

abstract.en: A conservationist is a librarian for things that cannot speak.
abstract.cn: 保护者就是替那些不会说话的万物做图书管理员的人。

abstract.en: Soil conservation is saving the ground under your feet for people not yet born.
abstract.cn: 土壤保护就是为你尚未出生的人保住脚下的土地。

examples.en: Conservationists argue that the marsh is worth more intact than drained.
examples.cn: 保护工作者主张，这片沼泽保持完整比排干更有价值。

examples.en: The soil conservationist showed farmers how to hold the topsoil.
examples.cn: 这位土壤保护工作者向农民示范如何保住表土。

examples.en: A conservationist at the museum cleaned the painting layer by layer.
examples.cn: 博物馆的一位文物保护者逐层清理了这幅画。

dict_mnemonic.text: conservation（保护）+ ist（人）→ 保护者

root: conservation 来自拉丁语 conservare「保持、保存」（com- 加强 + servare「守护」）+ 名词后缀 -ation；再加 -ist（希腊语 -istes，指从事某事的人）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all describe a person who keeps something valuable from being lost: nature, resources, wildlife, artworks, energy, soil, policy and a reserve.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都描述「防止珍贵之物丧失的人」：自然、资源、野生生物、艺术品、能源、土壤、政策与保护区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing between a valuable thing and its loss.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在珍贵之物与其丧失之间。

branches.en: THE CORE: the role is to keep ecosystems and the soil beneath them intact.
branches.cn: 核心：这个角色要让生态系统与脚下土壤保持完整。

branches.en: THE RESOURCE: wise use and efficiency are forms of keeping, not of abandoning use.
branches.cn: 资源：合理利用与效率也是「保存」的形式，而不是放弃使用。

branches.en: THE FIELD: wildlife work runs from tagging animals to managing a reserve day by day.
branches.cn: 野外：从给动物戴项圈到日常管理保护区，都属于这项工作。

branches.en: THE OBJECT: museums extend the same role to paintings and buildings.
branches.cn: 物品：博物馆把同一角色延伸到绘画与建筑上。

branches.en: THE RULE: protection often has to be won through law and funding.
branches.cn: 规则：保护往往必须通过立法与资金争取。

intro.en: Conservationist is a Latin verb of keeping, plus two noun-forming suffixes.
intro.cn: conservationist 是一个拉丁语「保存」动词加两个名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: Conservare joins com- and servare 'to keep'; -ation is Latin -atio; -ist is Greek -istes through Latin, marking a person.
latinIntro.cn: conservare 由 com- 与 servare「守护」构成；-ation 是拉丁语 -atio；-ist 经拉丁语上溯希腊语 -istes，标记人。

items.meaning: a person who protects valued things
items.example: The conservationist restored the hedgerow.
items.exampleCN: 这位保护者恢复了树篱。

items.example: Conservation of the marsh took decades.
items.exampleCN: 这片沼泽的保护花了几十年。

items.example: The scheme conserves both water and money.
items.exampleCN: 该方案既节水又省钱。

items.example: Conservationism shaped the forest service.
items.exampleCN: 资源保护主义塑造了林务机构。

items.example: Preserve and conserve share the keeping root.
items.exampleCN: preserve 与 conserve 共享「保存」词根。

items.example: The land was reserved for wildlife.
items.exampleCN: 这片土地被保留给野生生物。

items.meaning: to watch over, hence to notice
items.example: Observe and conserve share one Latin verb.
items.exampleCN: observe 与 conserve 共享一个拉丁动词。

items.meaning: cautious, tending to keep things as they are
items.meaningCN: 谨慎的，倾向维持现状的
items.example: Conservative politics and conservation share a root, not a programme.
items.exampleCN: 保守政治与资源保护共享词根，但不共享纲领。
